fusions.name: Cloud of Pecks
fusions.desc: Looses 5 darts at once, spread apart, each dealing 2 damage. You move 8% faster for 2 seconds after each volley.

fusions.name: Passed Along
fusions.desc: Spits a bead that deals 11 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Gathered Flock
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to call a flock for 12 seconds that pecks an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second.

fusions.name: Fattened Up
fusions.desc: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
